title: Koko-en — official history and nine-garden design

facts.fact: Koko-en opened on 29 April 1992 on the excavated site of the former west residence and samurai homes; it is not an untouched Edo-period garden.
Nine gardens follow the historical residential and passage layout, with tiled earthen walls, gates, water and traditional structures.
The Lord's Residence and tea garden with Souju-an are different garden spaces; the tea house has sukiya-zukuri design.
